header:
Challenger 32T22 BT (device cvt_mt5863_col, board TP.MT5510.PB781, MTK MT5659 / MT5863), Android 7.0 (API 24), firmware NRD90M 1464 (V8-MT659CO-A18V015)
Ultra low-spec budget TV (1 GB RAM, 8 GB Flash, MediaTek MT5659, CVTE / TCL ODM firmware for Challenger Colombia).

Apply:   TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/disable.sh examples/challenger-32t22bt/debloat.txt
Undo:    TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/restore.sh examples/challenger-32t22bt/debloat.txt com.cvte.tv.launcher
Everything is DISABLED, not uninstalled. Comment out any line you want to keep.

Stock launcher: com.cvte.tv.launcher (AppActivity). Pass it to restore.sh or set-home-activity if reverting.
Live TV & Inputs: keep com.cvte.tvservice, com.cvte.tv.androidsetting, and com.mediatek.tv.agent (needed for HDMI and TV tuners).

Tested on Challenger 32T22 BT: freed up crucial RAM for third-party launcher (com.gathin.tvhome) and streaming apps.
